messages.author: 3871a2787d9649e8
messages.subject: Deducer does not see the loaded dataset
parts: A few days ago I installed JGR and Deducer on a fresh installation of 32-bit Ubuntu 13.10 and I encountered a problem. When I load dataset (a csv file) from (with) Data Viewer I don't see it in the Deducer menus. I can use the loaded dataset from command line (from JGR console), but not from menus. If I load dataset with read.table() function I see it in menus too. What it could be?
